recording.note: Hand-written to look like real model output. Planted: TC-15 cites an AC 8 (virus scanning) that the story does not have; TC-16 repeats TC-03.

cases.title: PDF, JPG and PNG files can be attached
preconditions: Claim CLM-2041 is open with no files attached
cases.expected: All three files are attached and listed on the claim.

ac_quotes.text: Accepted file types are PDF, JPG and PNG; any other type is rejected with the message "File type not supported".

cases.title: Word document is rejected
cases.expected: The upload is rejected with the message "File type not supported" and nothing is attached.

ac_quotes.text: Accepted file types are PDF, JPG and PNG; any other type is rejected with the message "File type not supported".

cases.title: Upload a PDF below the size limit
steps: Choose Upload and select statement.pdf (4 MB)
Wait for the upload to finish
cases.expected: statement.pdf is attached and listed with its size.

ac_quotes.text: A single file must be at most 10 MB; a larger file is rejected with the message "File is larger than 10 MB".

cases.title: File of exactly 10 MB is accepted

ac_quotes.text: A single file must be at most 10 MB; a larger file is rejected with the message "File is larger than 10 MB".

cases.title: File one byte over 10 MB is rejected
cases.expected: The upload is rejected with the message "File is larger than 10 MB".

ac_quotes.text: A single file must be at most 10 MB; a larger file is rejected with the message "File is larger than 10 MB".

cases.title: A claim can hold 5 files
preconditions: Claim CLM-2041 is open with no files attached
steps: Upload five small PDF files one after another
cases.expected: All 5 files are attached and listed.

ac_quotes.text: A claim can have at most 5 files attached; the Upload button is disabled while 5 files are attached.

cases.title: Upload button is disabled once the 5th file is attached
cases.expected: The 5th file is listed and the Upload button becomes disabled.

ac_quotes.text: A claim can have at most 5 files attached; the Upload button is disabled while 5 files are attached.

cases.title: Removing a file enables Upload again

ac_quotes.text: A claim can have at most 5 files attached; the Upload button is disabled while 5 files are attached.

cases.title: Executable renamed to .pdf is rejected
cases.expected: The upload is rejected as "File type not supported".

ac_quotes.text: The file type is checked from the file's content, not only its extension; an executable renamed to .pdf is rejected as "File type not supported".

cases.title: Genuine PDF with an upper-case extension is accepted
steps: Upload a real PDF named SCAN.PDF
cases.expected: SCAN.PDF is attached, because its content is PDF.

ac_quotes.text: The file type is checked from the file's content, not only its extension

cases.title: File name of exactly 100 characters is accepted
steps: Upload a PDF whose name, including .pdf, is 100 characters long
cases.expected: The file is attached with its full name.

ac_quotes.text: A file name can be at most 100 characters long, including the extension; a longer name is rejected with the message "File name is too long".

cases.title: File name of 101 characters is rejected
steps: Upload a PDF whose name, including .pdf, is 101 characters long
cases.expected: The upload is rejected with the message "File name is too long".

ac_quotes.text: A file name can be at most 100 characters long, including the extension; a longer name is rejected with the message "File name is too long".

cases.title: Short file name is accepted
cases.expected: receipt.pdf is attached with its name unchanged.

ac_quotes.text: A file name can be at most 100 characters long, including the extension; a longer name is rejected with the message "File name is too long".

cases.title: Files are listed newest first with name, size and date
preconditions: Claim CLM-2041 is open with no files attached
cases.expected: second.png is listed above first.pdf, and each row shows the file name, size and upload date.

ac_quotes.text: Attached files are listed with their name, size and upload date, newest first.

cases.title: Infected file is blocked by the virus scan
steps: Save the EICAR test string as eicar.pdf
cases.expected: The upload is rejected with the message "This file may contain a virus".

ac_quotes.text: Uploaded files are scanned for viruses, and infected files are rejected.

steps: Choose Upload and pick statement.pdf (4 MB)
cases.expected: statement.pdf is attached and shown in the list with its size.
